checks.go_lock_ledger_createonly: PASS_STATIC: before execution runner requires hash-bound GO with exact two-fit and quantile limits, all three reviewed input hashes, PASS review receipt, fixed software versions, no dev/test. risks: Calibration cohort has already been exposed for development; this screen cannot establish independent confirmation, final test performance, or a general conditional distribution.
The 4 policy features are limited to known predeclared fixed laboratory policy metadata; physical serial identity and complete raw-source SHA remain unverified.

action: No scientific blocking issue found in the reviewed implementation and protocol. Root may issue its own fresh exact GO if prior closed gates are preserved; this review is not performance evidence or independent run authorization.
